profile.headline: Consultant at Morgan Stanley
profile.summary: +20 years of software development/support, data engineering experience in Finance, IT Service, Marketing, E-Commerce, Telecommunication, and Education

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
●	Implemented a successful self-service tool with backend system for access management to Snowflake DB/AZSQL SQL Server on Azure with Python, Flask,  SQLAlchemy, Postgre, BitBucket, Train CI/CD  using REST web service.
●	Contributed to ML & Data Science topics with ideas/suggestions.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant) - RF Sync
positions.description:
●	Implemented successfully high level (market, OSS) KPI trend dashboard & improved RF Sync tools and  ETL process using Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, MySQL, Jinja, Bootstrap,  Gerrit, Docker, Airflow, Gunicorn, Nginx, and Sentry monitoring tool (w/Django, Postgre & Redis)
●	Contributed to ML & Data Science groups with ideas/suggestions.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description:
●	Delivered successfully DBAP (DB Access Privileges) system using Python, IBM MQ, Splunk, SQL, Sybase, DB2 & CyberArk
●	Improved the performance of DB interface Web applications by redesign/rewriting using Perl, Python, jQuery, JavaScript, CSS, JSON, modperl, FastCGI, and SQL
●	Delivered successfully the sync process program that merges Wealth Management DB catalog in MSSQL into central Sybase metadata catalog DB using Perl, Sybase, and MSSQL
●	Migrated Web applications to Webfarm in success
●	Migrated DB Backup system from cron to metadata based one in success using Perl, SQL, Sybase, & DB2
●	Delivered Python based CLI tools successfully using Jira, Jenkins (CI), Git, BitBucket, Stash, Train  in SDLC
●	Contributed to the team projects by active suggestions/ideas through Agile Scrum
